 Injury Report: Week 10 vs Rams
 Check in on the health of the Cardinals heading into their Week 10 matchup with the Rams
 Nov 13, 2026 at 02:26 PM Zach Gershman azcardinals.com
 Copied! 
 FRIDAY REPORT
 For the first time since joining the Cardinals in 2023, the Cardinals will start a game without Hjalte Froholdt. The center was ruled out because of a concussion he sustained last week in Seattle. The Cardinals will also be without offensive lineman Jon Gaines II, which means Hayden Conner will be the starting center.
 Zach Carter, who logged three limited practices since coming off the Injured Reserve list, will also be inactive.
 The Cardinals listed six players as questionable, including tight end Hunter Long (knee), defensive lineman Roy Lopez (toe/ankle), cornerback Max Melton (knee/hand), defensive lineman Darius Robinson (wrist), left tackle Jayden Williams (knee), and safety Dewey Wingard (groin).
 Lopez returned to practice on Friday, as did Robinson, who was a DNP on Thursday. Robinson had a wrap on his wrist. If the Cardinals want Long to play, they would need to activate him to the 53-man roster by Saturday afternoon.
 The Rams ruled out tight end Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) and offensive lineman Steve Avila (hamstring). Outside linebacker Myles Garrett is questionable to play with a knee injury. He did not practice on Friday.
 THURSDAY REPORT
 Hjalte Froholdt missed another practice as the center remains in concussion protocol. If unable to practice on Friday and advance through the five phases for return-to-participation, Froholdt will miss his first game since joining the Cardinals in 2023. Hayden Conner would be the center for Carson Beck's debut.
 While a lot of attention has been on the offensive injuries, the defense is navigating multiple absences of their own. Outside linebacker Josh Sweat missed practice on Thursday because of a shoulder injury, as did safety Dewey Wingard (groin) and defensive lineman Roy Lopez (toe/ankle). Wingard was limited on Wednesday and downgraded on Thursday. Defensive lineman Darius Robinson (wrist) was a new addition as a DNP.
 Linebacker Mack Wilson Sr. (knee/ankle) and running back Bam Knight (concussion) were full participants at practice. It's a good sign that Knight will play this weekend after he previously wore the yellow non-contact uniform.
 The Rams injury report did not feature many changes. Tight end Davis Allen (oblique) was downgraded to a DNP and tight end Tyler Higbee did not practice because of an illness.
 WEDNESDAY REPORT
 The Cardinals offensive line on Sunday could resemble the unit Carson Beck started behind in the Hall of Fame game.
 With center Hjalte Froholdt in concussion protocol, offensive guard Jon Gaines II missing his eighth consecutive practice and left tackle Jayden Williams limited on Wednesday, the depth is being tested. Williams was wearing a sleeve on his left knee.
 The defense was missing key players as linebacker Mack Wilson Sr. and defensive tackle Roy Lopez did not participate. Lopez exited the Seahawks game with a toe/ankle issue, while Wilson has been playing through a knee injury. He also is listed with an ankle.
 Running back Bam Knight was sidelined last weekend after suffering a concussion in Dallas. He returned with the yellow non-contact jersey. Cornerback Max Melton (knee/hand), defensive lineman Dante Stills (shoulder), and safety Andrew Wingard (groin) were limited.
 In their first practice back while on IR, defensive lineman Zach Carter and tight end Hunter Long were also limited.
 The Rams, much like the Cardinals, are navigating through an injured roster. They held a walkthrough on Wednesday, making their designations estimations. Cornerback Trent McDuffie (back), wide receiver Puka Nacua (knee/toe), offensive lineman Steve Avila (hamstring), safety Kam Curl (toe), and tight end Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) did not participate.
